summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by ChipMOS TECHNOLOGIES INC., a foreign private issuer, reporting a board resolution that sets the ex-dividend record date for a cash dividend of NT$1.23 per common share from capital surplus. The record date is July 5, 2026, book closure from July 1-5, and payment date July 17, 2026. The filing contains no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, activist campaign, strategic review, or other special-situation event. It is purely a customary periodic disclosure of a dividend declaration and associated mechanics under Taiwan company law. No special situation exists; falls under 'None'.
